title: Optimizing Smart Grid Telemetry
business: Utility companies managing distributed smart grid sensors.
problem: High-frequency telemetry data from thousands of sensors causes ingestion bottlenecks and slow query performance for real-time grid balancing.
solution: InfluxDB 3 Core provides a high-speed, single-node engine that utilizes columnar Parquet storage and in-memory caching to enable sub-10ms query responses for recent telemetry data.
steps: Deploy InfluxDB 3 Core using the provided installation script on the edge server.
Configure the ingestion pipeline to map sensor IDs as tags and voltage readings as fields.
Utilize the native SQL interface to define time-windowed aggregations for grid load monitoring.
Leverage the built-in caching layer to serve the most recent 5-minute telemetry snapshots to the dashboard.
outcome: Improved grid stability through near-instantaneous visibility into sensor fluctuations and reduced infrastructure overhead.
limitation: InfluxDB 3 Core is optimized for recent data; heavy, long-range historical queries may require upgrading to the Enterprise version for distributed compute resources.
